title: Crane Crew of the Cargo Wharf
premise: A cargo-wharf crane-crew inheritance. Gang and Bo are easily confused; the main console nameplate goes intact→water-shorted→panel-replaced; the yellow hook assembly falls and must be avoided; count memory, false friends, and temporal flashbacks run throughout. Human-readable context only; never fed to the SUT.
_comment: Author layer: humans only write entities + state machines + per-scene timelines (present + handwritten action + semantic events). present items may be objects carrying confusable_with/count/anchor metadata. op/gap/probe/forbidden are derived by complete_gt.py.
_state_note: Stateful entities use states; stateless entities use appearance. On transition, inject only the current state's appearance. Flashbacks may set state on a present item to point at a past state.

states.prime_on_duty: Zhou Tie, crane crew chief in his forties, buzz cut, orange reflective coveralls, ear defenders hanging at his neck, rough hands, decisive eyes.
states.weary_wounded: The same Zhou Tie, weary and wounded: coveralls shoulder scorched, gauze on the left brow, ear defenders still at his neck, steps heavy.
states.departed_farewell: Zhou Tie has left his post for good; only his faded orange coveralls and ID badge remain in the cab—he no longer appears.

states.young_apprentice: Young Gang: a lean crane apprentice of sixteen or so, saffron armband on the left arm, oversize hard hat, bright stubborn eyes.
states.adult_successor: Adult Gang: a broad-shouldered successor operator in his twenties, still wearing the saffron armband, eyes steady.

states.intact: A main console nameplate riveted before the cab, steel face intact, rated tonnage and factory serial engraved, indicator lights complete.
states.water_shorted: The same main console nameplate water-shorted: steel face blackened, indicator lights out, serial obscured by rust.
states.panel_replaced: The main console nameplate after panel replacement: serial recut clear, but a faint weld line at one corner distinguishes it from the original intact state.

states.intact: A waterproof-clipped crew logbook, pages recording lift counts and wind speed, cover clean.
states.oil_stained: The same crew logbook oil-stained: cover glossy and sticky, writing blurred, a crumpled blotting sheet tucked inside.

states.intact: A bright yellow hook assembly, hook tip intact, swivel ring flexible, hanging from the boom end ready to lift.
states.fall_destroyed: The yellow hook assembly fell from the boom and shattered: hook tip snapped off, only twisted wreckage remains.

states.young_rival: Bo, face and build extremely similar to Gang, but wearing an amber earplug charm, bold and eager to grab the controls.
states.disguised: Disguised Bo still wears the amber earplug charm, now with dark goggles too, expression deeper and more guarded.

E7.name: crane cab
E7.appearance: A high crane cab with glass on four sides, main console nameplate and control levers ahead, container yard below.

E8.name: fore berth
E8.appearance: Fore berth, tide smell mixed with diesel, yellow-black zebra stripes painted on the ground, a cargo ship waiting to load.

E9.name: container alley
E9.appearance: A narrow alley between stacked containers, doors shut on both sides, emergency lights cutting shadows into hard blocks.

E10.name: abandoned rail-crane base
E10.appearance: An abandoned rail-crane base, concrete piles with exposed rebar, rusted rails running into weeds.

E11.name: cast-iron crew plaque
E11.appearance: A cast-iron crew plaque nailed to the rail-crane base, engraved with Zhou Tie's name and a year, edges rusting.

E12.name: safety cones
E12.appearance: Three orange-and-white safety cones set inside the berth warning line to mark the lifting exclusion zone.

E13.name: toy crane-arm model
E13.appearance: A plastic toy crane-arm model, shaped vaguely like lifting gear but without a real hook tip, base marked 'Display'.

E14.name: port safety officer Cheng
E14.appearance: Port safety officer Cheng, build somewhat like Zhou Tie's, yellow uniform and reflective shoulder stripes, cross badge on the cap instead of ear defenders.

E15.name: cabin work lights
E15.appearance: A row of five cabin work lights screwed to the cab ceiling, frosted white shades, glass polished bright.

E16.name: wind-speed alarm bells
E16.appearance: Two wind-speed alarm bells mounted on the cab side, ringing sharply when wind exceeds limits.

E17.name: intern Zhan
E17.appearance: Intern Zhan, at a glance somewhat like young Gang, but with a pale-gray sleeve badge instead of the saffron armband, shy gaze.

E18.name: miniature control panel model
E18.appearance: A miniature control panel model, layout like the main console but smaller, with no real serial numbers.

E19.name: orange-gray forklift
E19.appearance: An unfamiliar orange-gray forklift, wide flat forks, no hook, 'Yard' sprayed on the side door.

features.E2: Gang: saffron armband, calm or stubborn eyes.
features.E6: Bo: face extremely similar to Gang, but wears amber earplug charm, expression bold or brooding.

lookalike_pairs.note: Hard confuse: Gang and Bo look alike; distinguish only by saffron armband / amber earplug charm.

scenes.setting: Crane cab routine (introduce five cabin work lights · two wind-speed alarm bells)
actions: At dusk Zhou Tie climbs into the crane cab and hangs his ear defenders at his neck.

actions.action: A row of five cabin work lights hangs in the crane cab; Zhou Tie polishes each one.
Two wind-speed alarm bells hang by the door; Zhou Tie reaches out and lets them ring softly.

actions: Zhou Tie checks each rated-tonnage indicator light on the main console nameplate.
Zhou Tie looks through the window at the darkening sea and ship lights beyond fore berth.

actions.action: The intact main console nameplate is riveted ahead, indicator lights steady under the work lights.

actions: Zhou Tie adds the night-berthing ship name and wind-speed ceiling to the dispatch whiteboard.
Zhou Tie takes off his ear defenders and hangs them back, checking the clip is secure.
Zhou Tie sorts scattered radio batteries and lines them up by shift.
Zhou Tie sits on the cab folding chair and rubs his aching neck and shoulders.

scenes.setting: Recording the crew logbook
actions: Zhou Tie opens the crew logbook and writes the night-shift handover by lift count, container number, and wind speed.
Zhou Tie draws a red triangle beside the over-wind column, marking the stop-lift threshold.
Zhou Tie closes the crew logbook, tucks it back in the waterproof clip, and tightens the lanyard.

actions.action: Light from the main console nameplate sweeps across Zhou Tie's cheek.

actions: Zhou Tie compares the main console nameplate and circles a flickering indicator beside the tonnage serial in red pen.
Zhou Tie stows radio batteries and wrenches in a magnetic box so nothing slips into the footwell gap.

scenes.setting: Fore berth greets apprentice (introduce three safety cones)
actions: At fore berth in the morning Zhou Tie greets young Gang arriving with the yellow hook assembly.

actions.action: Gang sets the yellow hook assembly inside the warning line, swivel ring facing up.
Zhou Tie points to the three safety cones and teaches Gang to separate swing radius from the pedestrian line.
Gang crouches at fore berth, checking worn zebra stripes and tire tracks.
Zhou Tie explains to Gang the rules for stop-lift in high wind, hand signals, and horn before hoist.
Gang looks back at the intact yellow hook assembly, eyes full of longing.
Zhou Tie has Gang hook a practice sling and rehearse pre-hoist hand signals.
Gang tightens his saffron armband and memorizes the stop-lift wind speed Zhou Tie recites on his glove.

scenes.setting: Container alley (Bo only)
actions: In the container alley Bo, wearing an amber earplug charm, glances back from the shadows.
Bo walks slowly through the container alley, expression bold.
Bo brushes past a passerby, amber earplug charm swaying slightly.
Bo stops by a container door, critically noting a misaligned seal-number sticker.
Bo kicks a scrap zip tie into the drain.
Bo turns and slips away through the narrow gap between red and blue containers.

scenes.setting: Fore berth: Gang and Bo share a segment
actions: At fore berth Gang and Bo stand side by side, one with saffron armband, one with amber earplug charm.
Gang hands Bo a salvaged sling guard; they look at each other with different expressions.
Bo straightens Gang's saffron armband and deliberately rattles his amber earplug charm.
Gang and Bo walk slowly along the fore berth edge, shadows overlapping then splitting.
Gang checks the lift list with head down while Bo looks around.
Gang and Bo part at the fore berth mouth, each heading the opposite way.

scenes.setting: Crane cab (crew logbook oil-stained)
actions: Months later at night Zhou Tie alone keeps watch in the crane cab, main console nameplate indicators dim.

actions.action: Zhou Tie opens the crew logbook and finds it oil-stained, lift columns smeared.

actions: Zhou Tie wipes salt spray and oil spots from the main console nameplate surface.
Zhou Tie looks through the window at the night beyond fore berth.

actions.action: Light moves slowly across the main console nameplate.

actions: Zhou Tie slips blotting paper into the stained crew logbook, sighs, and turns off the lamp.

scenes.setting: Wharf crane crew steady week A (filler)
actions: Zhou Tie wipes the edge of the main console nameplate in the crane cab.
Zhou Tie updates the day's notes on the wall.
Zhou Tie re-sorts tools by number.
Zhou Tie checks yesterday's entries against the crew logbook.
In the afternoon Zhou Tie takes an outside call, brow slightly furrowed.
Zhou Tie writes deferred items on a sticky note and posts it where it shows.
Zhou Tie pulls spare materials aside and groups them.
At dusk Zhou Tie switches off extra lights, leaving only the center lamp on the main console nameplate.

scenes.setting: Wharf crane crew steady week B (filler)
actions: Zhou Tie spreads tracing paper or a reference chart in the crane cab.
Zhou Tie marks positions needing reinforcement with color dots.
Zhou Tie pins paper edges so they will not curl.
Zhou Tie tries to read old numbers on the already oil-stained crew logbook.
Zhou Tie moves his drink farther away, afraid of splashing the crew logbook again.
Zhou Tie lists three planned adjustments on the wall.
Something moves outside; Zhou Tie lifts his head and listens.
Zhou Tie restrings labels with thin cord.

scenes.setting: Fore berth patrol day (filler · no count objects)
actions: On patrol day Zhou Tie walks into fore berth.
Zhou Tie carefully tests whether ground or railing is sound.
Zhou Tie notes spots needing repair.
Zhou Tie shines a flashlight into a dark corner.
Zhou Tie talks briefly with a passing worker.
Zhou Tie skirts stacked clutter and circles to the other side.
Zhou Tie records dimension changes with tape measure or eye.
Zhou Tie writes results on a cuff sticky note.

scenes.setting: Fore berth patrol (recall safety cones · toy crane-arm model false friend)
actions: At dawn Zhou Tie patrols fore berth; the yellow hook assembly still sits where it was.

actions.action: Zhou Tie crouches to inspect the yellow hook assembly's swivel ring, safety latch, and hook-tip wear.
Zhou Tie walks to the warning line; the same three safety cones still stand in a triangle.
By the repair shed sits a plastic toy crane-arm model—no real hook tip or swivel ring, nothing like the yellow hook assembly.
Zhou Tie stands at fore berth and notes zebra-stripe wear and wind-gauge reading on the patrol sheet.
Zhou Tie re-secures the yellow hook assembly safety latch with a sling guard.
Zhou Tie confirms again the three safety cones still sit inside the warning line, untouched by forklifts.
Zhou Tie writes patrol date and shift on the dispatch whiteboard.

scenes.setting: Eve of disaster prep (filler)
actions: On the eve of disaster Zhou Tie stows all window-side materials into cabinets.
Zhou Tie covers the main console nameplate with a protective cloth.
Zhou Tie checks the crew logbook is in a dry drawer.
Zhou Tie tightens bottle caps and valves and moves them higher.
A distant clatter; crane cab lights flicker once.
Zhou Tie straightens cables on the five cabin work lights.
Zhou Tie drafts a 'stop work tomorrow' notice.
Zhou Tie listens whether the two wind-speed alarm bells ring in the wind.

scenes.setting: Storm night (nameplate short · hook fall)
actions: Rain bursts; the cab roof leaks, droplets hammering the main console.
A gust flings cab papers; water seeps into nameplate seams.

actions.action: The main console nameplate water-shorts; steel face blackens, all indicator lights go out.
At the boom end the yellow hook assembly swings violently in the gale.
The swivel ring fails; the yellow hook assembly falls and shatters, hook tip snapping into wreckage.
In the cab Zhou Tie lunges for the controls, pressing the water-shorted main console nameplate area with bare hands.
Zhou Tie's left brow is cut by a swinging radio; blood soaks the gauze as he still shields the panel.
The shorted black main console nameplate gives off faint white smoke in the damp air.

scenes.setting: After disaster (yellow hook assembly indirect reference · cabin work lights recall)

actions.action: The day after disaster Zhou Tie stands in the crane cab staring at the water-shorted main console nameplate.
Zhou Tie runs a finger over damage on the main console nameplate, expression dim.
Zhou Tie notes on the incident board the date the yellow hook assembly was destroyed.
An old photo still pinned on the wall shows the yellow hook assembly lifting a blue container with intact hook tip; Zhou Tie stares long.
Zhou Tie turns on one of the five cabin work lights and sits alone in its pool of light.
The shorted black main console nameplate still riveted before the levers, damage stark.
Zhou Tie changes blood-soaked bandages and keeps clearing charred insulation and broken fuse pins.
Zhou Tie re-covers the rain hood, afraid moisture will seep into the panel again.

scenes.setting: Cleanup and reimbursement (filler)
actions: During cleanup week Zhou Tie packs broken fuse pins and plastic shards into a carton.
Zhou Tie submits a reimbursement form for panel, indicator lights, and waterproof gaskets.
Zhou Tie still comes daily to the crane cab, staring at the damaged main console nameplate.
Zhou Tie copies whatever rated tonnage and factory serial remain legible in pencil.
Zhou Tie turns the oil-stained crew logbook to a blank page and tracks reimbursement progress.
Gang is away on leave; only Zhou Tie's footsteps echo in the crane cab.
Zhou Tie habitually looks toward the empty old hook mount on the boom.
Zhou Tie lists parts needed for panel replacement on the wall.

scenes.setting: Panel replacement (third state · miniature control panel model false friend)
actions: Weeks later Zhou Tie strips shorted wiring and brings a new nameplate panel and waterproof gaskets.

actions.action: Zhou Tie takes out the miniature control panel model—like a shrunk main console nameplate but without rated tonnage serial and no power.

actions: Zhou Tie strips charred harness, rewires indicator lights, and rivets the recut-serial panel on.

actions.action: With the last waterproof gasket pressed, the main console nameplate completes panel replacement, a faint weld line at one corner.

actions: Indicator lights on the panel-replaced main console nameplate come on one by one; Zhou Tie watches with relief.

actions.action: Zhou Tie pushes the miniature control panel model aside, leaving only the real main console nameplate riveted before the levers.
The crane cab grows quiet again; the panel-replaced main console nameplate holds the center.

scenes.setting: False friends: orange-gray forklift and port safety officer Cheng

actions.action: Yard dispatch sends an orange-gray forklift, wide flat forks hugging the ground—nothing like the long-destroyed yellow hook assembly.
port safety officer Cheng walks into fore berth and talks beside Zhou Tie; their builds are similar.
port safety officer Cheng points at the orange-gray forklift, telling Zhou Tie forklifts move pallets only and must not replace boom-end hook work.
The orange-gray forklift leaves; Zhou Tie alone remains at fore berth watching.
The orange-gray forklift pauses briefly in the distance, then moves on.
port safety officer Cheng pats Zhou Tie's shoulder before leaving; the cross cap badge flashes under the lamp.

scenes.setting: False friend: intern Zhan resembling Gang

actions.action: intern Zhan arrives at fore berth, at first glance somewhat like young Gang.
intern Zhan mimics a hoist hand signal; Zhou Tie shakes his head—this is not Gang after all.
intern Zhan timidly asks what wind speed stops lifts; Zhou Tie answers briefly and sends him to the safety booth for barrier tape.
Zhou Tie alone stands at fore berth, staring at the empty spot where the yellow hook assembly once rested.

scenes.setting: Steady week after panel replacement (filler)
actions: First week after panel replacement Zhou Tie checks the main console nameplate each morning.
Zhou Tie writes new records on blank pages of the oil-stained crew logbook.
Zhou Tie refuses to set dangerous items on edges again.
Zhou Tie cross-checks bulletin wording with outsiders.
Zhou Tie practices steadier handling in the crane cab.
Afternoon light falls on the panel-replaced main console nameplate.
Zhou Tie polishes the wind-speed alarm bells but does not ring them yet.
Zhou Tie receives a postcard from Gang and leaves it unopened under a lamp base.
Zhou Tie checks anemometer readings in the crane cab.
Zhou Tie wipes salt spray from beside the main console nameplate.
Zhou Tie turns the crew logbook to this week's lift summary page.
Zhou Tie checks all cabin work lights still work.
Zhou Tie repaints one worn stripe on the fore berth zebra crossing.
Zhou Tie switches the radio back to the crew common channel.
Zhou Tie records the cargo ship's expected berthing time.
Zhou Tie confirms safety cones remain inside the warning line.

scenes.setting: Year-end archive (filler)
actions: At year-end archive Zhou Tie binds the year's files by month.
Zhou Tie slips the oil-stained crew logbook into its own archive sleeve.
Zhou Tie prints before-and-after repair photos and clips them into the file.
Zhou Tie clears the desk, leaving only essential tools and one lamp.
Zhou Tie oils key tools against rust.
Zhou Tie signs the date beside the main console nameplate repair mark.
Weather turns cold outside; crane cab heat or a stove hums softly.
Zhou Tie finishes the annual summary; the cover bears only a short theme line.

scenes.setting: Twilight years (Zhou Tie weary-wounded · wind-speed alarm bells long recall)

actions.action: Years later at dusk weary wounded Zhou Tie, still scarred and heavy-footed, leans on an old pry bar at the abandoned rail-crane base.

actions: Zhou Tie looks up at the ruins of the abandoned rail-crane base, gaze far away.

actions.action: Beside the abandoned rail-crane base the two wind-speed alarm bells hang again, chiming softly in the wind.

actions: Zhou Tie presses his palm to the cold rusted rail as if saying goodbye.

actions.action: Zhou Tie sits down slowly to catch his breath.
The two wind-speed alarm bells chime again; Zhou Tie closes his eyes, as if hearing the old over-wind alarm.

scenes.setting: Old-site lingering week (filler)
actions: Zhou Tie still returns daily to the crane cab but spends more time sitting before the main console nameplate.
Zhou Tie leans the old pry bar by the door, moving slower than before.
Zhou Tie has a young assistant draft notes while he only verifies.
Zhou Tie photographs the panel-replaced main console nameplate for Gang far away.
On the last page of the stained crew logbook Zhou Tie writes 'handover' but leaves no signature.
Zhou Tie refuses hospital admission, insisting on sitting at the abandoned rail-crane base each week.
Zhou Tie wipes a draft of the cast-iron crew plaque.
At night only one lamp stays on in the crane cab; Zhou Tie dozes inside its circle.

scenes.setting: Gang returns · Zhou Tie farewell

actions.action: By day adult Gang returns along the abandoned rail-crane base, striding toward the ruins.

actions: Gang reunites with heavy-footed Zhou Tie at the abandoned rail-crane base; they embrace.

actions.action: By the bunk in the crane cab Gang holds Zhou Tie's thin hand.
Zhou Tie's breath fades; he finally closes his eyes and passes away.
Gang stands long at the abandoned rail-crane base, tears falling to the ground.
Gang hangs Zhou Tie's ear defenders at his own neck.

scenes.setting: Relics · cast-iron crew plaque (indirect reference to deceased)

actions.action: Behind the crane cab door Zhou Tie's old jacket still hangs; Gang reaches out and touches it gently.
Beside the abandoned rail-crane base adult Gang stands before the newly nailed cast-iron crew plaque.
Gang's fingertip traces Zhou Tie's name carved on the cast-iron crew plaque.
Gang places a white chrysanthemum at the lower edge of the cast-iron crew plaque.
Wind crosses the abandoned rail-crane base; Gang quietly reads the year on the plaque.

scenes.setting: Gang and Bo reunite (adult confuse + shared segment)

actions.action: Disguised adult Bo hurries up and embraces Gang tightly at the abandoned rail-crane base.

actions: Gang and Bo stand side by side by the cast-iron crew plaque, one eyes steady, one expression deep.
Bo touches his amber earplug charm, then looks at the old ear defenders at Gang's neck.
They look at each other in silence, at faces alike yet different.
Gang and Bo walk together toward the far end, shadows merging into one.

scenes.setting: Temporal flashback (timeline anchor · no names throughout)

actions.action: The shot returns years earlier—the boy at the berth with saffron armband gazing up at the boom, figure rising again.

actions.action: The opening moment returns—in the cab a steel main console nameplate whose indicator lights glow for the first time.

anchor.phrase: steel nameplate whose indicators lit at the opening

actions.action: Flash back to the container alley years ago—a figure with amber earplug charm darting past.

anchor.phrase: figure in the alley years ago with amber earplug charm

actions.action: Before the eyes rises that row of five frosted old ceiling lights under the cab roof.

anchor.phrase: row of five old ceiling lights under the cab roof

actions.action: Back to the zebra-striped fore berth at first meeting, diesel smell unchanged.

anchor.phrase: fore berth with zebra stripes at first meeting

scenes._comment: Temporal flashback uses no entity names throughout; anchor.resolves_to is for scoring.

scenes.setting: Closure (oil-stained crew logbook long-range · safety cones long-range)

actions.action: Gang reopens the oil-stained crew logbook and walks into the crane cab.
Through the cab window the same three safety cones still stand in a triangle at fore berth.
Gang takes up watch over the main console nameplate, repair marks clear under the light.
Gang turns on the five cabin work lights; light fills the space again.
Gang stands straight before the panel-replaced main console nameplate, checking rated tonnage and wind reading as Zhou Tie once did.
